{"summary":"The mgmt cluster shows no critical or high vulnerabilities, no secrets and no Trivy misconfigs listed in the digest. The main risks are in Argo CD: the platform project has wildcard destinations, sources and cluster resources, and the argocd-manager ServiceAccount holds cluster-admin. Remaining items are low-to-medium hardening gaps (seccomp, mutable root filesystems, unpinned Argo revisions, 8 MEDIUM image vulnerabilities). Node and control-plane CIS checks were not performed.","targets":["mgmt"],"frameworks":[{"name":"NSA","passed":14,"failed":6,"skipped":6,"score":75.0},{"name":"MITRE","passed":12,"failed":4,"skipped":6,"score":80.0}],"findings":[{"severity":"HIGH","title":"Argo CD ServiceAccount bound to cluster-admin combined with unrestricted 'platform' AppProject","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/argocd-manager (ServiceAccount kube-system/argocd-manager); AppProject/platform","controls":[],"evidence":"The digest shows argocd-manager bound to cluster-admin and the platform project with wildcard_destination, wildcard_sources and all_cluster_resources all true, with app 'alloy' deployed from it.","fix":"Restrict the project, e.g. spec.destinations: [{server: <cluster>, namespace: <ns>}], spec.sourceRepos: [<repo-url>], spec.clusterResourceWhitelist: [<only needed kinds>]; then replace the cluster-admin binding with a scoped ClusterRole if Argo CD does not need full admin."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Argo CD applications tracking moving revisions, root app in default project","resource":"Application/root (project default, revision HEAD); Application/alloy (project platform, revision main)","controls":[],"evidence":"The digest flags 'root' at HEAD in the default project and 'alloy' at 'main', so any push to those refs is deployed, and the unrestricted platform project amplifies the impact.","fix":"kubectl -n argocd patch app root --type merge -p '{"spec":{"project":"<restricted-project>","source":{"targetRevision":"<tag-or-commit-sha>"}}}' (repeat for alloy)."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Pods missing seccomp profile","resource":"2 workloads (not named in digest)","controls":["Trivy PSS 10 (Seccomp)"],"evidence":"Trivy PSS reports control 10 Seccomp failed on 2 resources; 16 of 17 PSS controls passed.","fix":"securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault"},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Medium-severity image vulnerabilities","resource":"Cluster images (not itemised in digest)","controls":[],"evidence":"Trivy k8s counts 8 MEDIUM vulnerabilities and no CRITICAL/HIGH; fixed versions are not given in the digest.","fix":"Run 'trivy k8s --report all --severity MEDIUM' to list packages and fixed versions, then bump the affected images."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"cluster-admin bound to system:masters group","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin (Group system:masters)","controls":[],"evidence":"The digest shows cluster-admin bound to Group system:masters, which looks like the Kubernetes default binding.","fix":"No change needed; restrict membership of system:masters through certificate issuance and avoid using it for routine access."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Mutable container filesystems","resource":"4 resources, e.g. argocd/Deployment/argocd-server","controls":["C-0017"],"evidence":"Kubescape C-0017 (Immutable container filesystem, LOW) failed on 4 resources.","fix":"securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
# mount emptyDir for paths that need writes"},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Low-severity Trivy misconfigurations","resource":"Cluster resources (not itemised in digest)","controls":[],"evidence":"Trivy k8s counts 4 LOW misconfigurations, with no details listed.","fix":"Run 'trivy k8s --report all --scanners misconfig' to identify and fix them."}],"not_checked":[{"item":"node and control-plane CIS checks","reason":"need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"},{"item":"git history","reason":"secrets removed from history are not scanned"},{"item":"Details of NSA (6) and MITRE (4) failed controls","reason":"the digest lists only C-0017 among failed controls, so the other failures could not be assessed"},{"item":"Per-CVE package and fixed-version data","reason":"the digest gives only counts for the 8 MEDIUM vulnerabilities"}]}
